summary:
{
  "approach": "Extend the active NightLight indicator, not the inactive raja.bar copy. Treat temperature as blue-light-filter color temperature in kelvin, subject to user confirmation. Keep the existing primary-click toggle; route a confirmed touchpad secondary click exclusively to a small anchored slider panel. Opening or closing the panel must not toggle or change temperature. Use the local monitor panel's PanelSlider interaction pattern as a reference, not its brightness commands or numeric limits.
Before implementing service calls, obtain the external omarchy.nightlight and qs.Ui contracts: effective/current temperature versus configured target, units and limits, manual override setter and reset behavior, change notifications, BarIndicator button signal, and panel anchoring/lifecycle. Do not guess API names or substitute an independent display-control process that could compete with the existing service.
Bind the bar readout to the service-reported effective temperature, with an explicit unavailable state. Keep slider draft value separate from confirmed service state while dragging; initially prefer local preview and one validated commit on release. Only add debounced live application if supported and desired. Clamp to documented service limits, retain pending/error distinctions, and resynchronize on external updates without pulling the thumb during a drag. Manual/automatic status and a return-to-automatic action should reflect actual supported service semantics.
A text readout needs a narrowly targeted host sizing exception: Indicators.qml currently injects a fixed horizontal icon-slot width and icon font size. Preserve neighboring indicators' geometry and order. The host also instantiates inactive and active copies and hides inactive indicators in a drawer; keep service state authoritative, prevent duplicate writes, and ensure the panel remains usable across enabled-state changes and drawer collapse.
